cards.ex: He thought he could get away with cheating on the exam, but he got caught.
cards.exUz: U imtihonda aldash bilan qutulib ketishni o'yladi, lekin ushlandi.
cards.uzDef: Qilmishiga yarasha jazo olmaslik, qutilib ketmoq.

cards.ex: He had to serve time for armed robbery.
cards.exUz: U qurolli talonchilik uchun qamoq muddatini o'tashga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qamoqda jazoni o'tamoq, qamoq muddatini o'tamoq.

cards.ex: The thief is finally behind bars where he belongs.
cards.exUz: O'g'ri nihoyat panjara ortida, uning joyi o'sha yer.
cards.uzDef: Qamoqda, ozodlikdan mahrum bo'lgan holatda.

cards.ex: The judge threw the book at him for his repeated offenses.
cards.exUz: Sudya uning takroriy jinoyatlari uchun unga eng qattiq jazoni qo'lladi.
cards.uzDef: Qonun bo'yicha eng qattiq jazoni qo'llamoq.

cards.ex: He only got a slap on the wrist for such a serious crime.
cards.exUz: U shunchalik jiddiy jinoyat uchun faqat yengil jazo oldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda yengil jazo, ogohlantirish kabi.

cards.ex: The police let him off with a warning this time.
cards.exUz: Politsiya bu safar uni ogohlantirish bilan ozod qildi.
cards.uzDef: Jazolamasdan ozod qilmoq, kechirmoq.

cards.ex: You can't take the law into your own hands; call the police.
cards.exUz: Siz qonunni o'z qo'lingizga ololmaysiz; politsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qiling.
cards.uzDef: Qonunni o'z qo'liga olmoq, o'zboshimchalik qilmoq.

cards.ex: He learned the hard way that crime doesn't pay.
cards.exUz: U jinoyatning befoydaligini qiyin yo'l bilan o'rgandi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat oxir-oqibat foyda keltirmaydi, jazolanadi.

cards.ex: The company is currently under investigation for fraud.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya hozirda firibgarlik uchun tergov ostida.
cards.uzDef: Hozirda tergov qilinmoqda, tekshirilmoqda.

cards.ex: Eventually, he had to face the music for his actions.
cards.exUz: Oxir-oqibat, u o'z harakatlari uchun javobgarlikka tortilishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Qilgan ishlari uchun javobgarlikka tortilmoq, oqibatlariga duch kelmoq.

cards.ex: They were caught cooking the books to avoid paying taxes.
cards.exUz: Ular soliq to'lamaslik uchun buxgalteriya hisobotlarini soxtalashtirayotganda ushlanib qolishdi.
cards.uzDef: Buxgalteriya hisobotlarini soxtalashtirmoq, aldash uchun o'zgartirmoq.

cards.ex: The police had a stakeout near the suspect's house.
cards.exUz: Politsiya gumondorning uyi yaqinida poyloq o'tkazdi.
cards.uzDef: Politsiya tomonidan kimnidir yashirincha kuzatish, poylamoq.

cards.ex: The officer put handcuffs on the suspect.
cards.exUz: Ofitser gumondorga kishan soldi.
cards.uzDef: Qo'llarni bog'lash uchun ishlatiladigan metall moslama, kishan.

cards.ex: He decided to plead guilty to avoid a lengthy trial.
cards.exUz: U uzoq davom etadigan sud jarayonidan qochish uchun aybini tan olishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sudda aybini tan olmoq.

cards.ex: She pleaded not guilty and insisted on her innocence.
cards.exUz: U aybsizman deb aytdi va o'zining begunohligini ta'kidladi.
cards.uzDef: Sudda aybsiz ekanligini aytmoq.

cards.ex: As part of his sentence, he had to do community service.
cards.exUz: Jazosining bir qismi sifatida u ijtimoiy ish bilan shug'ullanishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyatchilar uchun jazo turi, jamiyatga foydali ish.

cards.ex: He's on probation after being released from prison.
cards.exUz: U qamoqdan chiqqanidan keyin sinov muddatida.
cards.uzDef: Ozodlikda, lekin nazorat ostida bo'lish, sinov muddati.

cards.ex: Having a criminal record can make it hard to find a job.
cards.exUz: Jinoyat tarixiga ega bo'lish ish topishni qiyinlashtirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Avval qilingan jinoyatlar haqidagi ma'lumotlar, jinoyat tarixi.

cards.ex: He was lucky to get off scot-free after causing the accident.
cards.exUz: U baxtga ko'ra, baxtsiz hodisaga sabab bo'lganidan keyin quruq qutuldi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday jazo olmasdan qutulmoq, jazolanmasdan qolmoq.

cards.ex: The manager turned a blind eye to the employee's misconduct.
cards.exUz: Menejer xodimning noto'g'ri xatti-harakatlariga ko'z yumdi.
cards.uzDef: Bilmaganga olmoq, e'tibor bermaslik, ko'z yummoq.

cards.ex: The police are cracking down on drunk driving.
cards.exUz: Politsiya mast holda mashina haydashga qarshi keskin choralar ko'rmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir qarshi keskin choralar ko'rmoq, qattiq kurash olib bormoq.

cards.ex: The police suspect it was an inside job because of how easily they got in.
cards.exUz: Politsiya buni ichki ish deb gumon qilmoqda, chunki ular juda oson kirishgan.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat, ichkaridan yordam bergan odamning ishtiroki bilan sodir bo'lgan.

cards.ex: If you break the law, you have to pay the price.
cards.exUz: Agar qonunni buzsaiz, to'lovni to'lashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xato yoki jinoyat uchun oqibatlarini boshdan kechirmoq, to'lovni to'lamoq.

cards.ex: With the suspect in custody, the detective declared, "Case closed!"
cards.exUz: Gumondor qo'lga olingandan so'ng, detektiv e'lon qildi: "Ish yopildi!"
cards.uzDef: Ish yakunlandi, tergov tugadi.

cards.ex: The company had to foot the bill for the legal fees.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yuridik to'lovlar uchun xarajatni qoplashi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni to'lamoq, pulni to'lamoq.

cards.ex: He's doing hard time in a maximum-security prison.
cards.exUz: U maksimal darajadagi xavfsizlik qamoqxonasida qattiq qamoq jazosini o'tamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qamoqda og'ir sharoitlarda muddat o'tamoq, qattiq qamoq.

cards.ex: He was arrested for trying to falsify documents to get a loan.
cards.exUz: U kredit olish uchun hujjatlarni soxtalashtirishga uringani uchun hibsga olindi.
cards.uzDef: Hujjatlarni soxtalashtirmoq, qalbaki qilmoq.

cards.ex: The bank robber is still on the run from the FBI.
cards.exUz: Bank talonchisi hali ham FBI dan qochib yuribdi.
cards.uzDef: Politsiya yoki hokimiyat tomonidan qidirilayotgan va yashirinmoqda.

cards.ex: They managed to pull off a heist at the museum without getting caught.
cards.exUz: Ular muzeyda ushlanmasdan talonchilik qilishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Talab qilinadigan talonchilikni muvaffaqiyatli amalga oshirmoq.

cards.ex: His actions were a serious breach of trust.
cards.exUz: Uning harakatlari jiddiy ishonchni suiiste'mol qilish edi.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchni suiiste'mol qilish, xiyonat qilish.
